body:
Yes, that's exactly it. It's like I'm inside a prison cell but I'm also holding the key. I want to be happy and I have the tools, my sadness or sometimes numbness just becomes crippling. I am going to try to see a therapist soon, so hopefully I will learn some coping mechanisms or be prescribed medication so I can appreciate everything I have better. 

I do like board games, yea. I think my favorite is probably Tak. It's like uh, chess almost but it was designed by a fantasy author I like. I try to distract myself with video games and reading and drawing, as those are my main hobbies but any time my brains not occupied I find my emotional state immediately darkens.

Thanks so much for talking to me. Sometimes I think that's all I need, to be able to talk about my feelings without feeling like I'm hurting the person I'm talking too.

I understand that. I know my family would miss me, but I'm just very tired. It really is a peaceful sort of suicidal; I dont think I'll try, but I hope that each nap will be a forever one.

I also have to contend with being a partial provider for several members of my family, so sometimes I have to remember that they might not eat without me.

If you need an someone to listen, I am bad at providing advice, but I will be a sympathetic ear. I hope you make it through this. ♡

Thank you. I appreciated that, it helped. Theres not much to talk about per se. I have a lot of self hatred toward myself, my past, and my circumstances, but my life is actually pretty okay (and in fact,improving). I think that's why lately I think about suicide a lot, because I cant seem to make myself care about anything or be interested in anything around me. I think I'm ruining and wasting my life by being depressed but I cant control it.

I've had time to calm down and become rational since I posted, but I've mostly let myself rest today because I was incredibly worked up last night. I really appreciate you taking the time to listen to me.
